summary: Re-review of 3581902..edee50b (tasks 4.9e, 4.9f, 4.13c, 4.13d, rulings commit 154eb7d). C1 to C6 are resolved; C7 stays open as a nit. The message-line contract holds end to end: the call stdin holds review-prompt.md, the message line, and the seeded diff in that order (M1, M2). A missing or empty message file refuses with exit 2 before the lock, the quota read, and the call (M3, M4). seed-messages.ts writes one file per diff, prints one line `seed-messages: <n> written` on exit 0, and every exit-2 refusal writes no file (SM1 to SM3). The backfill left 14 non-empty message files for mg-2026-11a and 6 for mg-2026-11p, so the probe tonight (02:00 +07 on 2026-11-19) finds the message file of its control diff. judges.json holds the three D11 judge routes with the specified quota fields. judge-run.sh accepts a route only from judges.json, and review-run.sh never reads it (J15 to J17). Both outside-repo drivers now hold the pilot routes in the D12 order deepseek, hy4, mimo. The night driver reads the newest pass record and appends exit=<rc> state=<state>, and the probe driver starts every refusal line with the route. All three allowed suites pass at HEAD (43, 9, 22 tests) with no orphan process after the last two. The first suite's immediate pgrep held one transient process under a concurrent same-suite run in another session; a delayed check found no leftover. Four nonblocking findings stay: the P2 retry-count pin that spec D14 names is not made, the stale 4.10 sequencing text, the untested arg-level refusals of seed-messages.ts, and C7.
nonblocking_findings: C7 (nit, harness/model-guide/judge-run.sh:600): judged_by marks every item id of a complete group as judged, also when the model answer dropped that id and it holds no verdict. Unchanged since 3581902. Fix: keep only the ids that hold a verdict.

R1 (minor, harness/model-guide-tests/review-run.test.ts:1668-1670 against measure/tracks/model_guide/spec.md:714-715): spec D14 says the 3-call probe ceiling is pinned 'as test P2 pins', but P2 asserts only that the call count is greater than 0. No test pins the retry count on the error path. Fix: pin `modelCalls(...).length` to 3 in P2, or drop the pin claim from D14.

R2 (nit, measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:1817): row 4.10 says the probe of 2026-11-19 'runs before 4.9f', but 4.9f is complete and the probe needs its message files, so it runs after 4.9f. Stale sequencing text with no live impact tonight. Fix: change the sentence to 'runs after 4.9f and before 4.11'.

R3 (minor, harness/model-guide/seed-messages.ts:64-86,141-146): the arg-level refusals (set id given twice, unknown flag, flag without value, bad set-id pattern, missing set folder, no diff) hold no test case; the nine cases cover the happy path, the four diff checks, and scope. Fix: add one case per arg-level refusal.

R4 (nit, pre-existing, harness/model-guide/review-run.sh:11 and :153): the header says --date defaults to today in UTC, but DATE uses local `date +%F`. The night driver uses the same local date, so the record lookup matches. Fix: align the header text with the code.
